| [CLAIM-154](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-154.md) | A candidate structure is worth naming as a unit when its effect-to-noise ratio outruns the Occam cost of keeping it: reify when d'² exceeds the log prior-to-posterior variance ratio | Dual-filed from [MOM-CLM-160](https://github.com/dmarx/mathematics-of-meaning/blob/main/record/claims.d/CLM-160.md) ([ADR-037](../../../record/decisions.d/ADR-037.md)). By the Savage–Dickey ratio, ln BF(keep) = ½(d'² − Occam), so a direction, block or sector is real enough to name exactly when δ/ε > τ with τ² = ln(s²/σ²), the information the data added about it. In this record it prices the boundary tests for a combined form: a near-decomposable block ([LIT-905](../../../record/literature.d/LIT-905.md)) earns a name when its gap beats its Occam factor. Re-checked here in the conjugate case. | Active |
| [CLAIM-157](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-157.md) v2 | Relative to a stated target, a combined form is one system while its joint dynamics are nearly decomposable with the form as a block whose gap beats the Occam factor, and it lasts as long as that block persists; the unit is the gap-isolated block, not any member | The record's proposed answer to [QUESTION-035](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-035.md), joining the dual-filed MOM results. | [CLAIM-161](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-161.md) | A system persists as the same self over an interval when a coherence measure is approximately conserved along its own trajectory, not merely matched by some map between its states | Dual-filed from [MOM-CLM-153](https://github.com/dmarx/mathematics-of-meaning/blob/main/record/claims.d/CLM-153.md) ([ADR-037](../../../record/decisions.d/ADR-037.md)). The corpus's selfhood condition, that some map φ preserves a coherence score γ, is satisfied by any two systems with similar scores. Proposed here because γ is unspecified. | Proposed |

| [CLAIM-164](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-164.md) | What a spectral gap makes definite is the subspace of the cluster it isolates, not a single direction: the gap picks the object, and the object is a vector only when its own gap is wide | Dual-filed from [MOM-CLM-144](https://github.com/dmarx/mathematics-of-meaning/blob/main/record/claims.d/CLM-144.md) ([ADR-037](../../../record/decisions.d/ADR-037.md)). Under a perturbation δT, the subspace spanned by a cluster of singular values separated by a gap δ rotates by at most ‖δT‖/δ (Davis–Kahan), whatever happens to the vectors inside it. So the well-defined unit is the gap-isolated projector. Re-measured here. With [CLAIM-154](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-154.md) it is a criterion: the gap picks the object, and the Occam factor says whether the gap is big enough. | Active |
| [CLAIM-167](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-167.md) | One-way drive rightly passes the threshold criterion: a metronome and its musician, or a nerve and its muscle, form one system relative to a target that needs both, and the direction of coupling gives the system's internal architecture, not its membership | The owner's challenge to the open objection, 2026-10-11: "a metronome driving a musician, or a nerve driving a muscle, passes — and why shouldn't they?" | [CLAIM-172](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-172.md) v4 | Mutual entrainment is a sufficient mark of a combined form, and marks it as one of peers: when each side adjusts the other's timing the pair carries a collective variable neither has alone; one-way drive also makes a combined form, with a hierarchical architecture | The record's reading in answer to the owner's prompt of 2026-10-11, "connect extended self to entrainment".
